'''July 2001 Cedar Grove tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cedar Grove, NJ on 21 July 2001. [[T.J. Holman]] won it. It is known from Pete Flamini's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2676">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-21-god-i-hate-cedar-grove-nj-7-21-01d2676/ god-i-hate-cedar-grove-nj-7-21-01], DeckTech (Pete "Ghetto 13" Flamini, 21 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-21-god-i-hate-cedar-grove-nj-7-21-01d2676/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[T.J. Holman]]
